description: This file implements classes related to Application Waiting Controller (AWC), including notifier and listener classes that manage application state change notifications and listener registration.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages registration of listeners for application state changes and notifies them.

classes.name: AWCListener
classes.description: Receives notifications about window and application state changes, forwarding relevant information to the notifier.

methods.name: void addListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: void removeListener(AWCStateChangeListener * listener)
methods.description: Removes a specified listener from the notifier.

methods.name: void notify(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of an application state change.

methods.name: void notifyWindowChange(int window_id VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,awc::AWCClient::awc_window_state_t window_state VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED,unsigned int pid VARIABLE_IS_NOT_USED)
methods.description: Placeholder method for window change notifications; intentionally left empty.

methods.name: void notifyStateChange(int req_id,awc::awc_app_state_t app_state,int status,unsigned int pid)
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications and forwards to the notifier.

methods.name: void notifyServiceReady()
methods.description: Placeholder for service ready notification; currently does nothing.
